**Which page?**
<!-- The URL, or the course and section number, e.g. stats-1/correlation or §1.17 -->

**What is wrong?**
<!-- Quote the sentence, or name the readout and the settings that produce it. -->

**What do you believe is correct, and how did you check?**
<!-- A published table, G*Power, R, SPSS, or a textbook page reference all count.
     If you are not sure what the right answer is, say so and report it anyway —
     "this looks off" is still worth knowing. -->

**Anything else?**
<!-- Browser, screen size, or a screenshot, if it is a display or interaction problem. -->
